verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street's own materials cover the O-1 in depth, including a founder-specific O-1 guide and F-1/J-1-to-O-1 transitions. They also include an O-1 vs EB-1 comparison that offers some guidance on choosing, and they claim a general 'suite of visas and green card pathways.' The rest of the startup visa menu named in the story is not evidenced. missing for 10: H-1B coverage (including cap-exempt routes), E-2 coverage, TN coverage, broader green-card path coverage beyond the EB-1 comparison, and a selection framework spanning all these options.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's own materials cover the full startup visa menu — O-1, H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2, TN, and the green-card paths — with guidance on choosing the right one for my situation

citations.quote: We offer a suite of visas and green card pathways for technologists at any point in their U.S. immigration journey
As a startup founder, you can indeed apply for an O-1 visa if you can demonstrate your extraordinary abilities and achievements in your field.
Option to apply via an agent instead of an employer.
We design the right visa up front
